why_best: It visually communicates iteration and dynamic renewal in a way that resonates instantly with an audience accustomed to modern mobile application updates.
why_bad: A simple cross-dissolve or basic geometric slide would feel generic and miss the chance to reinforce the theme of active, intelligent platform evolution.
trap: Allowing the color contrast between added and deleted elements to become overly chaotic will clutter the narrow vertical viewport instead of conveying a clean system refresh.
